Budget slice (spec Touchpoint 4 'Fail-Closed Budget Behavior') of the LLM usage ledger. Add a pre-call hard-budget check to the existing Claude dispatch seam: when a configured hard budget is set and the preflight prompt-size estimate EXCEEDS it, BLOCK the request (skip the provider spawn) and write a decision.kind=blocked ledger record before any call. SAFETY: when no hard budget is configured (the default) OR the ledger flag is OFF, dispatch is BYTE-IDENTICAL to today (no block, decision proceeds with budgetPolicyId=null). The block alters control flow ONLY when an operator explicitly sets the hard-budget env var AND the estimate exceeds it. Per the spec: do not invent a budget when none is configured; fail closed only on an explicit configured hard budget. The pure block-record builder + budget-policy resolution live in the usage-ledger module (zero cross-module imports); the lattice-dispatch.ts edit is a minimal gated guard. Scope: packages/main/src/core/usage-ledger/dispatch-usage.ts + the single gated guard in core/lattice-dispatch.ts (runClaudeCodeRealLeafDispatch) + a smoke + package.json. Out of scope: postflight overage handling beyond recording, Authority-required budget modes, any non-claude host, default-on, signed-receipt path.
